description:
SEMANTIC news search across ALL covered asset classes — stocks, FX, crypto, COMMODITIES (metals
    like copper/gold, energy like oil), and private companies. Articles matched by MEANING, impact-labeled
    (title, publisher, entities, direction, why). USE THIS for 'copper news', 'metals', 'gold', etc.
    instead of a web search. `entity_type` keeps only stock/forex/crypto/commodity/private hits. For a
    FILTERED feed by aspect/direction/country use `news_feed`. `limit` = how many (default 20, max 50).
    TIME-SCOPE with `from_`/`to` (ISO dates, e.g. '2026-04-01') or a `window` ('90d','qtd','ytd','1y').
    ⚠️ News coverage starts 2026-01-01 — older ranges return nothing (that's no COVERAGE, not 'no news').
    Returns {match_quality, top_similarity, note, results}. If match_quality is 'weak'/'none', the corpus
    has no strongly relevant news — do NOT present these results as evidence; say so and use another route.

collapse.description: Merge near-duplicate stories (same article from many outlets) into one row + `dup_count`. Default ON; pass `false` for the raw un-deduped feed.
collapse.title: Collapse

detail.description: `compact` (default): per story title, date, publisher, types, impact_score, a short brief and the TOP-3 impacted entities (direction + relevance + one-line why) — fits the client's tool-output limit. `full`: every impacted entity with all its aspects (bigger; use with a small `limit`).
detail.title: Detail

entity_type.description: Keep only hits of one kind: `stock`|`forex`|`crypto`|`commodity`|`private`. Omit → all.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

format.description: `json` (default): structured rows. `text`: the same stories as plain readable lines (no JSON keys / quotes / nesting) — about half the size; prefer it when you only need to READ the news to answer.
format.title: Format

from_.description: Lower time bound, ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD`. ⚠️ Ava Advisor NEWS coverage starts 2026-01-01 (nothing before).
from_.title: From

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, hard cap 50). Keep SMALL + narrow the scope; page/refine rather than dump — heavily-covered assets have hundreds of articles.
limit.title: Limit

q.description: Free-text SEMANTIC news query — a topic/event/asset in any language ('copper', 'oil shock', 'Fed rate hike', 'ข่าวทองคำ').
q.title: Q

window.description: News-recency window: `7d`/`30d`/`90d`/`180d`/`1y` or `mtd`/`qtd`/`ytd`. Omit → a sensible default. (Price history is unaffected — this only scopes the NEWS lens.)
window.title: Window

name: search_news
title: Search News
